subject: Follow-up: Dedicated inference needs, isolation & scaling plan
messages:
From: mateo_alvarez <mateo@redwood.ai>
To: sarah.lin@bluecrest.ai
Cc: ben_carter <ben@redwood.ai>, jordan_blake <jordan@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 13 Aug 2025 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: Dedicated inference needs, isolation & scaling plan

Hi Sarah —

Thanks again for your time today. Quick recap from our side so we have alignment before we loop in Eng/SE: 

Pain points you shared:
- Production latency spikes during peak inference windows (paying for p95 latency and saw 3x tail).
- Strict data isolation requirement for PHI-containing payloads; legal requires tenant-level separation and audit logs.
- Unpredictable burst traffic tied to batch ingestion jobs — need both steady reserved throughput and burst capacity.

Goals you want to hit in the next 90 days:
- Move 2 LLM-powered endpoints to a dedicated pool with tenant isolation (PII/PHI) by end of Q3.
- Achieve p95 generation latency <= 350ms for short-form prompts (<= 512 tokens) and consistent throughput of ~120 qps sustained.
- Establish an ops playbook and canary rollout path with rollback policies and automatic fallback to a compatible model.

What we propose (high level):
1) Dedicated pool (reserved GPUs) sized for baseline 120 qps + headroom for 2x burst.
2) Tenant isolation (dedicated nodes + network controls) and KMS integration for keys.
3) Autoscale & burst policy for short spikes; canary policy for model rollouts.
4) SLA: target 99.9% uptime for the committed pool + latency SLO tracked per-route (we'll draft specifics).

Attachments: attached a short MOP (MOP-v1.pdf) with our recommended pool sizing and ops cadence; SLA draft attached for reference.

Next steps we agreed:
- SE deep-dive to validate model footprint (quantization, KV caching opportunities) — aim to schedule next Tue/Wed.
- Procurement: draft the SLA and the reservation options (monthly vs annual) and share a commercial outline.
- Ops: draft the canary/rollback playbook and sample monitoring dashboard items.

Can you confirm the goals above are accurate and whether Wed Aug 20 or Thu Aug 21 (morning PT) works for a 60-min SE deep dive?

Thanks,

Mateo Alvarez
Account Exec — Redwood Inference
mateo@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0143

[Attachment: MOP-v1.pdf (PDF)]
[Attachment: SLA-draft-BlueCrest-2025.docx (DOCX)]

From: sarah.lin@bluecrest.ai
To: mateo_alvarez <mateo@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 14 Aug 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Dedicated inference needs, isolation & scaling plan

Thanks Mateo — this summary looks right and is helpful. A few clarifications: 

- The 120 qps baseline is accurate; peak bursts can reach ~280 qps for short periods (3–7 minutes) when batch jobs complete.
- Latency target: 350ms p95 is our customer-facing SLO for the blue model; for some heavier prompts we accept slower but want the tail bounded.
- Isolation: legal insists on physical tenant isolation or a validated dedicated pool with strict audit trail — we'd prefer physical isolation if feasible.

We can do Tue Aug 20 at 11:00 AM PT for the SE deep-dive. Please include any SE who can drive quantization/benchmarking recommendations.

I'll loop in procurement after your commercial outline so we can start paperwork if the sizing and SLA look reasonable.

— Sarah
Sarah Lin
Head of ML Infrastructure — BlueCrest AI
sarah.lin@bluecrest.ai
[BlueCrest internal procurement: procurement@bluecrest.ai]

From: ben_carter <ben@redwood.ai>
To: mateo_alvarez <mateo@redwood.ai>, jordan_blake <jordan@redwood.ai>
Cc: sarah.lin@bluecrest.ai
Date: Fri, 15 Aug 2025 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Follow-up: Dedicated inference needs, isolation & scaling plan

Forwarding Mateo's recap and Sarah's confirmation. Notes from an ops/SE lens: 

- Initial sizing: recommend a 6-GPU reserved pool (A100/Equivalent) with a 2x burst bucket handled by ephemeral capacity or burst slots. That matches 120 qps sustained + 280 qps short spikes given the model family Sarah referenced.
- Isolation options: we can offer single-tenant pool with tenant affinity (preferred) or a physically isolated cluster at the provider level — needs procurement/regional availability check.
- Latency: p95 350ms is achievable with KV cache priming and 8-bit quantization in many cases; will validate on the SE call.
- Observability: propose route-level p50/p95/p99, token counts, model mismatch alerts, and a synthetic prompt suite for regression detection.

Action items for the SE call (Tue 8/20 11:00 AM PT):
1) Model artifacts: Sarah to share model name and a 1–2 sample prompts (non-PHI) for benchmarks.
2) Mateo to send procurement outline + initial commercial (monthly vs 12-month commit) before the call.
3) Ben to prepare a short benchmark plan and a runbook for canary release + rollback.

I'll be on the call — Adam (bench engineer) will join to run quick quantization/latency checks.

Ben Carter
Solutions Engineering — Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.ai
[Attachment: bench-plan-outline.txt (TXT)]

Thanks all — confirming the SE deep-dive on Tue Aug 20 at 11:00 AM PT. Quick commercial note attached: two pricing lanes (monthly reserved pool vs 12-month committed pool) plus an add-on for physical isolation if needed.

Attached the commercial outline and a slightly updated MOP that includes the canary cadence we discussed. For the call, Sarah — if you can share the model name and one redacted prompt by EOD Mon we can pre-populate the benchmark suite.
